sql: SELECT p.strategy, count(*) AS trades, count(DISTINCT split_part(p.market_ticker,'-',1)) AS series, round(avg(p.assumed_price)::numeric,1) AS avg_px, round((100.0*sum(p.pnl)/nullif(sum(p.quantity),0))::numeric,2) AS c_per_ct, round(sum(p.pnl)::numeric,2) AS pnl, round((100.0*avg(CASE WHEN p.pnl>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))::numeric,1) AS win_pct FROM paper_trades p WHERE p.market_ticker LIKE '%MENTION%' AND p.status <> 'open' AND p.closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.strategy HAVING count(*) >= 10 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 25
